warnThresholdsDescription: Manage what happens to a member who reaches a number of warnings.
addDescription: Set the action taken when a member reaches a number of warnings.
removeDescription: Remove the action of a number of warnings.
listDescription: List the thresholds of warnings of the server.
optionsCountDescription: The number of active warnings that triggers the action.
optionsActionDescription: The action taken on the member.
optionsDurationDescription: How long the action lasts, such as 1d. Leave empty for a permanent one.
optionsPeriodDescription: Only count the warnings of this period, such as 30d. Leave empty to count every active one.
removed: The action of {{count}} warnings was removed.
notFound: There is no action for {{count}} warnings.
limit: The server already has {{maximum}} thresholds, the most it can have.
listEmpty: The server has no thresholds of warnings. Add one with `/warn-thresholds add`.
